decisions.rationale: Firstmate decision react-forms-lab-scope (captain-authorized, inbox 001, 2026-11-18) adopted reconciler option A verbatim. The reconciler verified the implementation at commit 89064f80: the r2 snapshot lab.json is byte-identical to that commit (sha256 e33fcf1a...). Compared field by field with the r1 snapshot at 402c4853: covers (six topics), objectives (17), test (all 8 failingTests names), minutes (25/30) and trackRequirement are unchanged; only prerequisites and cleanup.notes differ. The S32-only allowance sentence in cleanup.notes is replaced by the two-slot sequencing the decision specifies: tasks 1-3 in the S32 guided-lab slot; tasks 4-8 on S33 after that day's teach-then-check steps, as interim coded practice for P3-P5 while the course project artifact remains deferred. The README adds a 'When to do the tasks' note: tasks 1-3 on S32, tasks 4-8 on S33 after its create/edit/delete, submission-error and Testing Library lessons. module.json sourceCoverageNotes replaces the old 'covering the three S32 topics' entry with the six-topic, two-slot note that cites react-forms-lab-scope option A. git diff 402c4853..89064f80 touches no topic.json. Tests changed only through the separately accepted r1 test fixes. The two-slot split matches the verified dependency seam: tests 4-7 need tasks 1-3, and test 7 also needs tasks 4 and 6. Sanity run on the final bytes: the reference passes 8/8 and the shipped starter fails all 8 under the same names. The sequencing defect is resolved as decided.

Firstmate decision react-forms-lab-scope (captain-authorized, inbox 001, 2026-11-18) adopted reconciler option A verbatim. The reconciler verified the implementation at commit 89064f80: the r2 snapshot lab.json is byte-identical to that commit (sha256 e33fcf1a...). The decision keeps the 25/30 allowance under owner directive 95387e98. It requires the record to say that 25/30 covers the whole two-slot task set and is planning evidence, not a measured pilot. Verified: lab.json minutes are still {estimatedMedian 25, cap 30}. cleanup.notes now reads 'The 25-minute median and 30-minute cap cover the whole two-slot task set; they are planning evidence, not a measured learner pilot', and module.json carries the same disclosure. The critic's honesty concern is answered by disclosure and the two-slot spread, without inventing a re-estimate, and the accepted friction fixes (README coupling, troubleshooting, TASK 2 and step 5 wording) are present in the 89064f80 diff. Re-timing remains for a future learner pilot.
